Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and the quality commitment is where that starts. Our options put quality at the centre and set a chargeback that no longer weighs on your side.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

On energy costs:
German electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 36.75.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 37.08.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 37.31.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a quality commitment you can plan production around, with no chargeback per complaint.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This Angebot is valid for 30 days.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We can drop the price to 46.50 EUR for this setup. Also, we really need to talk about payment terms, because late payments are a headache for us right now and we need faster payments. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Dear Mr Lis,

You asked which volume we can commit to. Every option below carries a binding volume, so that question is answered in the terms themselves, and it is the same across all three.

Faster payment stays fixed in this enquiry, and I will not hold out something we cannot stand behind. What we commit to is this: under Option A we pay every invoice on its agreed due date.

Option A is the package we can approve. It keeps your quality commitment and puts no chargeback on any complaint, so a complaint no longer weighs on your side. In return, the price has to come down to the level shown.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.82.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.91.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.87.
Binding volume in every option: 15,900 units a year over 12 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
